title: No Verified Incident, No Excuse for an Unregulated Dog Trade
excerpt: Rabies exposure can kill without urgent care. Verified evidence must guide reform—not myths about tradition, farm-raised dogs, or stolen companions.
body_html:
A rabies exposure can become fatal once symptoms appear. Wounds need immediate washing with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes, followed by urgent medical assessment and post-exposure treatment before symptoms develop. That human stake demands evidence, not slogans.

Facts first. Claims second.

Available source material does not provide a verifiable police seizure, court judgment, named transport interception, cyanide incident, or official finding proving that specific dogs entered Vietnam’s meat trade through theft. It also does not establish that no dog farms exist. Those claims require primary records, named agencies, dates, locations, and source links. They cannot be filled with assumptions.

Biosecurity risk remains real

WHO states that rabies spreads when infected saliva enters bites, scratches, broken skin, or mucous membranes. Once clinical symptoms appear, rabies is virtually 100% fatal. Properly cooked meat is not an established rabies transmission route. Uninspected animal handling, slaughter, transport, and bite exposure raise different biosecurity concerns; none should be blurred into one unsupported causal claim.

Demand records. Demand protection.

Vietnamese families, pet guardians, veterinarians, and local reformers deserve transparent enforcement: traceable transport, quarantine controls, humane animal protection, and public reporting. SDE’s campaign demand goes beyond any single health target: complete abolition of the dog meat trade by 2030. Sign the national petition. Add your name to a public demand for action, and follow campaign updates reaching decision-makers.

facebook_post:
Rabies control cannot stop at household gates. It starts with one hard rule: facts before slogans.

Rabies spreads when infected saliva enters bites, scratches, broken skin, or mucous membranes. WHO advises washing wounds with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes, then seeking urgent medical care. Vaccination and, when indicated, rabies immunoglobulin or approved monoclonal antibodies must come before symptoms. Once symptoms appear, rabies is virtually 100% fatal.

That risk demands accountable animal transport, quarantine enforcement, humane handling, and transparent inspection. It also demands honesty. Current source material does not verify specific theft rings, cyanide incidents, court convictions, seizures, or claims that no dog farms exist. Unsupported claims weaken Vietnamese families, pet guardians, veterinarians, and reformers who deserve credible evidence.

Lawful activity, regulatory breaches, criminal theft, and SDE’s proposed abolition are different matters. Keep them distinct. Build reform on records, not rumor.

SDE calls for complete abolition of the dog meat trade by 2030. Add your name to that public demand and help move it toward decision-makers.
